units.source_text: 次日早晨，二女公子好容易分娩，生下一个男孩儿。

en.t: The next morning, the Second Princess at last gave birth safely to a boy.

units.source_text: 匂亲王的操心不曾白费，非常高兴。

en.t: Prince Niou's anxious care had not been in vain, and he was overjoyed.

units.source_text: 薰大将在升官之喜上又添了这一件喜事。

en.t: For General Kaoru, this happy event was added to the joy of his recent promotion.

units.source_text: 为了答谢他昨夜出席飨宴，又兼庆贺他弄璋之喜，立刻亲到二条院来，站着应酬了一会。

en.t: To thank him for attending the banquet the night before, and also to congratulate him on the birth of his son, Kaoru at once came in person to Nijo-in and exchanged greetings for a while while standing.

units.source_text: 因为匂亲王闭居在二条院中，所以没有一人不到这里来贺喜。

en.t: Because Prince Niou was staying secluded at Nijo-in, everyone came there to offer congratulations.

units.source_text: 致送产后礼物、第三日的祝贺，照例只是匂亲王家内私人参加。

en.t: The postpartum gifts and the celebration on the third day were, as usual, attended only by members of Prince Niou's household and close private circle.

units.source_text: 第五日晚上，薰大将致送屯食五十客、赌棋用的钱、盛在碗里的饭——这些都照世间常例。

en.t: On the evening of the fifth day, General Kaoru sent fifty portions of tonjiki food, money for the go wagers, and bowls of rice, all according to common custom.

units.source_text: 另有赠与产母的，是叠层方形食品盒三十具、婴儿衣服五套以及襁褓等物。

en.t: In addition, for the mother he sent thirty sets of stacked square food boxes, five sets of baby clothes, swaddling cloths, and other such things.

units.source_text: 这些礼物装潢并不华丽，以免旁人注目。

en.t: These gifts were not decorated lavishly, so as not to attract other people's attention.

units.source_text: 但细看起来，件件非常精致，显见薰大将用心异常周到。

en.t: But when examined closely, every item was extremely refined, plainly showing how exceptionally thoughtful General Kaoru had been.

units.source_text: 还有赠与匂亲王的，是十二具嫩沉香木制的方几，高脚木盘上盛着点心。

en.t: For Prince Niou as well, there were twelve square stands made of young aloeswood, with sweets arranged on high-legged wooden trays.

units.source_text: 赏赐二女公子的侍女的，叠层方形食品盒自不必说，还有桧木制食品盒三十具，内盛各种各样的食物。

en.t: For the Second Princess's waiting women, besides the stacked square food boxes, there were also thirty cypress-wood food boxes filled with all kinds of foods.

units.source_text: 但都不特地装潢，以免旁人注目。

en.t: Yet none of them was specially decorated, in order to avoid drawing attention.

units.source_text: 第七日晚上，明石皇后为之举行祝贺仪式，前来参加的人非常众多，自中宫大夫以至殿上人及高官贵族，不可胜数。

en.t: On the evening of the seventh day, Empress Akashi held a celebration for the child, and so many people came that they could not be counted, from the Grand Steward of the Empress's Household to courtiers, high officials, and nobles.

units.source_text: 今上闻知匂亲王生了儿子，说道：“匂皇子初次做父亲，我岂可不庆祝！”便御赐佩刀一具。

en.t: When the reigning emperor heard that Prince Niou had had a son, he said, "Prince Niou has become a father for the first time; how could I fail to celebrate?" and bestowed a ceremonial sword.

units.source_text: 第九日晚上是夕雾左大臣的祝仪。

en.t: The evening of the ninth day was the celebration hosted by Yugiri, the Minister of the Left.

units.source_text: 夕雾对二女公子虽然没有好感，但恐匂亲王心中不欢，所以也派诸公子前来道喜。

en.t: Although Yugiri had no affection for the Second Princess, he feared displeasing Prince Niou, and so he too sent his sons to offer congratulations.

units.source_text: 此时二条院内无忧无虑，喜气洋洋。

en.t: At this time, Nijo-in was free of cares and filled with festive joy.

units.source_text: 二女公子几月以来心多愁闷，身患病苦，一直忧伤烦恼。

en.t: For several months the Second Princess had been burdened with sorrow, troubled by illness, and constantly distressed and anxious.

units.source_text: 如今连日喜庆，脸上增光，心情也该稍稍宽慰了。

en.t: Now, with celebration following day after day, her face regained some brightness, and her heart must have found a little comfort.

units.source_text: 薰大将想道：“二女公子做了母亲，今后对我势必更加疏远。

en.t: General Kaoru thought, "Now that the Second Princess has become a mother, she will surely grow even more distant from me.

units.source_text: 而匂亲王对她的宠爱势必更深了。”

en.t: And Prince Niou's love for her is certain to deepen still more."

units.source_text: 他心中甚是遗憾。

en.t: He felt deeply disappointed at heart.

units.source_text: 但念这原是自己当初的愿望，则又觉不胜欣慰。

en.t: Yet when he remembered that this had originally been his own wish, he also felt immeasurably consoled.
